name: The Slope Gives Way

npcs.name: Berto
dialogue: Aftershocks and heavy rain have loosened the plateau slope. A fresh slide can move again without warning.
Keep everyone off the hillside and use the marked stable path.
after_dialogue: The slope is still shifting after the quake. We will report the blocked path and stay uphill.

choice.prompt: The shortest path crosses a fresh slope failure. Which route?

options.text: Take the longer marked stable route
options.result: You keep clear of unstable ground.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.result: Loose slopes can move again without warning.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Liza
dialogue: I was checking the trail when the hillside gave way. My leg hurts, and rocks are still falling.
Please bring the first-aid kit. Then help me follow the safe route.
after_dialogue: Thank you for the first aid. I can follow you, but let's stay well away from the slope.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need the first-aid kit. Please bring it, then help me get to the marked route, away from the unstable slope.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the marked route, away from the unstable slope now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the first-aid kit, then speak with Liza again.

quests.title: Collect the emergency flashlight for the search team
Find First-aid kit for the response team
Rescue Liza and get them to safety

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety. During shaking: Drop, Cover, Hold On.

quests.evacuate: Reach Sturdy Shelter and stay clear of danger.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Learn local landslide warning signs, hazard maps, and evacuation routes before heavy rain.
If a slide threatens, avoid its path and move to a safe area as directed by local officials.
After a slide, stay away from the affected slope because further movement may occur.

quiz.question: You see signs of a possible landslide near your route. What is safest?
options: Avoid the slide path and move to a safe area following local instructions
Go closer to inspect the slope
Cross the debris to reach the road
quiz.explanation: Avoid landslide paths, move to a safe area, and follow local authority guidance.

briefing: Earthquake-weakened slopes fail in heavy rain. Keep away from the slide path, choose the longer stable route, and help stranded residents without entering unstable debris. Recover the monitoring records from the damaged station.
story_clue: The records show artificial energy pulses shortly before the earthquake.
